import thinkthen as tt

# three messages name one team each: billing, shipping,
# and account. The fourth names a parcel and a login, so
# no team reaches 0.9 and it prints None
teams = ["billing", "shipping", "account"]
for text in ["Please refund the extra fee on my invoice.",
        "My parcel went to the wrong address.",
        "I cannot reset my password.",
        "My parcel never came, and now I cannot log in to track it."]:
    print(tt.choose("Which team owns this?", text,
        options=teams, threshold=0.9))
